# Loading

Loading useful packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(compositions)
```

Loading raw data

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv("data/raw/validations-reseau-ferre-profils-horaires-par-jour-type-2eme-trimestre.csv", sep = ";")
colnames(raw_data)
```

# Recovering altered data

```{r}
raw_data <- raw_data %>% mutate(
  ID_ZDC = if_else((
    CODE_STIF_ARRET == "ND" & 
      CAT_JOUR == "SAVS" & 
      CODE_STIF_TRNS == "100"
  ),
  71799, 
  ID_ZDC
  ),
  LIBELLE_ARRET = if_else((
    CODE_STIF_ARRET == "ND" & 
      CAT_JOUR == "SAVS" & 
      CODE_STIF_TRNS == "100"
  ),
  "PTE D.BAGNOLET", 
  LIBELLE_ARRET
  ),
  CODE_STIF_RES = if_else((
    CODE_STIF_ARRET == "ND" & 
      CAT_JOUR == "SAVS" & 
      CODE_STIF_TRNS == "100"
  ),
  "110", 
  CODE_STIF_RES
  ),
  
  CODE_STIF_ARRET = if_else((
    CODE_STIF_ARRET == "ND" & 
      CAT_JOUR == "SAVS" & 
      CODE_STIF_TRNS == "100"
  ),
  "684", 
  CODE_STIF_ARRET
  )
)
```

# Column selection and translation

Selecting appropriate columns and translating them

```{r}
data <- raw_data %>% mutate(
  station_id = paste(
    CODE_STIF_TRNS, 
    CODE_STIF_RES, 
    CODE_STIF_ARRET, 
    sep = "_")
) %>% select(
  station_id,
  ID_ZDC,
  LIBELLE_ARRET,
  CAT_JOUR,
  TRNC_HORR_60,
  Pourcentage_validations
) %>% rename(
  connection_id = ID_ZDC,
  station_name = LIBELLE_ARRET,
  day_cat = CAT_JOUR,
  time_slot = TRNC_HORR_60,
  percentage_entering = Pourcentage_validations
)

head(data)

unique(data %>% pull(time_slot))
```

Transforming time slots into start time points

```{r}
ts_to_stp <- c(
  "0H-1H"= 0,
  "1H-2H"= 1,
  "2H-3H"= 2,
  "3H-4H"= 3,
  "4H-5H"= 4,
  "5H-6H"= 5,
  "6H-7H"= 6,
  "7H-8H"= 7,
  "8H-9H"= 8,
  "9H-10H"= 9,
  "10H-11H"= 10,
  "11H-12H"= 11,
  "12H-13H"= 12,
  "13H-14H"= 13,
  "14H-15H"= 14,
  "15H-16H"= 15,
  "16H-17H"= 16,
  "17H-18H"= 17,
  "18H-19H"= 18,
  "19H-20H"= 19,
  "20H-21H"= 20,
  "21H-22H"= 21,
  "22H-23H"= 22,
  "23H-0H"= 23
)

data <- data %>% mutate(
  time_slot = ts_to_stp[time_slot]
)
```

Translate day categories:

- WD: Working day (outside of school holidays periods)

- WDSH: Working day during school holidays

- SA: Saturday (outside of school holidays periods)

- SASH: Saturday during school holidays

- SUPH: Sunday and bank holidays

```{r}
translate_day_cat <- c(
  "JOHV" = "WD",
  "JOVS" = "WDSH",
  "SAHV" = "SA",
  "SAVS" = "SASH",
  "DIJFP" = "SUPH"
)

data <- data %>% mutate(
  day_cat = translate_day_cat[day_cat]
)
```

# Removing wrong data

## Removing non-defined data

Removing unknown stations

```{r}
data <- data %>% filter(station_name != "Inconnu")
```

Checking `connection_id`

```{r}
any(is.na(data$connection_id))
```

There are non-defined connections, let's inspect them

```{r}
data %>% filter(is.na(connection_id))
```

It is normal since there are no connection zone in the Orly Airport, we will handle it later.

Checking that there is only one `station_name` per `station_id`

```{r}
data %>% select(station_id, station_name) %>% group_by(station_id) %>% distinct(station_name) %>% count() %>% filter(n != 1)
```

Checking `day_cat`

```{r}
unique(data$day_cat)
```

Checking `time_slot`

```{r}
data %>% filter(is.na(time_slot))
```

The corresponding percentage is null, they do not carry information so we discard them

```{r}
data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(time_slot))
```

Inspecting `percentage_entering`

```{r}
data %>% filter(is.na(percentage_entering) | percentage_entering < 0 & percentage_entering > 100)
```

Checking that all day types exists for each station

```{r}
data %>% select(station_id, day_cat) %>% distinct() %>% group_by(station_id) %>% count() %>% ggplot(data = ., aes(n)) + geom_bar()
```

## Removing inconsistent data

Checking that all distributions sum up to 100%

```{r}
data %>% group_by(station_id, day_cat) %>% summarise(tot = sum(percentage_entering)) %>% ggplot(data = ., aes(tot)) + geom_bar()
```

There is some inconsistency (probably associated to number rounding), we will correct it later. Checking if all points exists

```{r}
data %>% group_by(station_id, day_cat) %>% count() %>% ggplot(data = ., aes(n)) + geom_bar()
```

Checking which time point is mostly missing

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(time_slot)) + geom_bar()
```

Given that every distributions sums up to approximately 100%, we can add missing points by giving them a zero value.

```{r}
data <- data %>% complete(
  time_slot, 
  day_cat, 
  nesting(station_id, 
          connection_id, 
          station_name
  ), 
  fill = list(percentage_entering = 0.)
)
```

Checking zero values

```{r}
data %>% filter(percentage_entering == 0) %>% ggplot(data = ., aes(day_cat)) + geom_bar()
```

```{r}
data %>% group_by(time_slot) %>% summarize(zero_freq = mean(percentage_entering  == 0)) %>% plot()
```

There is no clear cut-off, we transform all zero values in near-zero values

```{r}
data <- data %>% mutate(percentage_entering = ifelse(percentage_entering == 0, 0.01, percentage_entering))
```

We check normalization

```{r}
data %>% group_by(station_id, day_cat) %>% summarise(tot = sum(percentage_entering)) %>% ggplot(data = ., aes(tot)) + geom_bar()
```

```{r}
data %>% group_by(station_id, day_cat) %>% summarise(error = (sum(percentage_entering)-100)/0.01)
```

```{r}
normalise <- function(vec){
  error <- round((sum(vec) - 100) * 100)
  nb_changes <- abs(error)
  sgn <- sign(error)
  return(vec - sgn * 0.01 * rmultinom(1, nb_changes, prob = vec * (100 - vec)))
}

data <- data %>% group_by(station_id, day_cat) %>% mutate(percentage_entering = normalise(percentage_entering)) %>% ungroup()
```

# Creating useful data containers

3D array with rows as stations, columns as day types and cells (or depth) as the hourly distribution

```{r}
array_3d <- data %>% select(
  station_id, 
  day_cat, 
  time_slot,
  percentage_entering
) %>% pivot_wider(
  names_from = day_cat, 
  values_from = percentage_entering
) %>% {split(.[setdiff(names(.), "time_slot")], .$time_slot)} %>% 
  map(~ .x %>% 
        column_to_rownames('station_id') %>% 
        as.matrix) %>% 
  simplify2array
```

3D array with Centred Log Ratio Transformation applied

```{r}
array_3d_clr <- aperm(apply(array_3d, c(1, 2), clr), c(2, 3, 1))
```

Tibble with station information

```{r}
stations <- data %>% select(
  station_id, 
  connection_id, 
  station_name
) %>% distinct()
```

# Saving cleaned data for next steps

```{r}
write.csv(data, "data/processed/cleaned_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(stations, "data/processed/stations.csv", row.names = FALSE)
save(array_3d, file = "data/processed/array_3d.rda")
save(array_3d_clr, file = "data/processed/array_3d_clr.rda")
```

To load data contained in `.rda` files, use for example `load("data/processed/array_3d.rda")`. It will load `array_3d` in the environment.
